title: The Pilgrims' Bridge
text: A narrow rope bridge sways over a gorge toward the shrine. A toll-keeper sits at its foot, hooded, a basket at his side heaped with rings, letters, teeth and locks of hair. Each pilgrim must leave something behind, he says. Something that matters.

options.label: Leave coin in the basket, and hope it matters enough.

outcomes.text: He lets you pass with a blessing, and does not look at the coin.

options.label: Each Scion leaves a sin behind, and crosses lighter for it.

outcomes.text: Lighter, every one. He puts the sins in the basket with the teeth.

options.label: Push past him onto the bridge. No toll-keeper owns the road to the gods.

outcomes.text: The shrine will not open for you, and what you did here is written down somewhere.
